passages.text: ​ (amounts in millions, except share and per share data, unless otherwise noted) ​ The following discussion and analysis of the financial condition and results of operations for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023 has been derived from and should be read in conjunction with the Consolidated Financial Statements and the accompanying Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements included in Part II, Item 8, herein for Amphenol Corporation (together with its subsidiaries, “Amphenol,” the “Company,” “we,” “our,” or “us”). The Consolidated Financial Statements have been prepared in U.S. dollars, in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America (“U.S. GAAP” or “GAAP”). The following discussion and analysis also includes references to certain non-GAAP financial measures, which are defined in the “Non-GAAP Financial Measures” section below, including “Constant Currency Net Sales Growth” and “Organic Net Sales Growth”. For purposes of the following discussion, the terms “constant currencies” and “organically” have the same meaning, respectively, as these aforementioned non-GAAP financial measures. Refer to “Non-GAAP Financial Measures” within this Item 7 for more information, including our reasons for including non-GAAP financial measures and material limitations with respect to the usefulness of the measures. ​ In addition to historical information, the following discussion and analysis also contains certain forward-looking statements that are subject to risks and uncertainties, including but not limited to the risk factors described in Part I, Item 1A. Risk Factors herein, as well as the risks and uncertainties that exist with the use of forward-looking statements as described in the “Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements” section included herein at the beginning of this Annual Report on Form 10-K (“Annual Report”). ​ Overview ​ General ​ Amphenol is one of the world’s largest designers, manufacturers and marketers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial, high-speed, fiber optic and specialty cable. In 2025, approximately 65% of the Company’s sales were outside the United States. The primary end markets for our products are: ​ ● information technology and communication devices and systems for the converging technologies of voice, video and data communications; ​ ● a broad range of industrial applications and traditional, hybrid and electric automotive applications; and ​ ● defense and commercial aerospace applications. ​ The Company’s products are used in a wide variety of applications by a broad array of customers around the world. The Company competes primarily on the basis of technology innovation, product quality and performance, price, customer service and delivery time. For many years, customers have generally been consolidating their lists of qualified suppliers to companies that have the ability to meet certain technical, quality, delivery and other standards while maintaining geographic flexibility and competitive prices. Management believes that these non-GAAP financial measures may be helpful to investors in assessing the Company’s overall financial performance, trends and year-over-year comparative results, in addition to the reasons noted below. Non-GAAP financial measures related to operating income, operating margin, net income attributable to Amphenol Corporation, effective tax rate and diluted EPS exclude income and expenses that are not directly related to the Company’s operating performance during the years presented. Items excluded in the presentation of such non-GAAP financial measures in any period may consist of, without limitation, acquisition-related expenses, refinancing-related costs, gains associated with bargain purchase acquisitions, the excess tax benefits related to stock-based compensation and certain other discrete tax items including, but not limited to, (i) the impact of tax audits relating to prior periods and (ii) significant changes in tax law. Non-GAAP financial measures related to net sales exclude the impact of foreign currency exchange rates and acquisitions. credit_strengths.text: Amphenol's operating margin expanded sharply year over year and now sits well above the information technology sector median, reflecting pricing power and mix in interconnect systems across IT, industrial and aerospace end markets. This earnings quality underpins cash generation and cushions the enlarged debt stack.

Operating cash flow covers capital expenditure plus shareholder distributions by a comfortable multiple, and free cash flow alone covers dividends and buybacks, so internal liquidity funds growth without relying on external refinancing. Cash balances are substantial relative to the debt stack.

key_risks.text: Gross leverage rose year over year and now sits above the sector median, driven by a debt stack that more than doubled as acquisitions were funded. Net leverage remains modest but is slightly above the sector median, so further debt-funded deals would erode the current cushion.

The debt note shows meaningful near-term maturities, including senior notes and Euro notes falling due within the coming year and a large floating rate note due shortly after. Refinancing concentrates execution risk in a higher-rate environment, and the floating rate tranche adds coupon sensitivity.

Disclosed risk discussion highlights reliance on non-GAAP measures and acquisition-related charges, while roughly two-thirds of sales are outside the United States. Currency translation and integration of acquired businesses could pressure reported margins and complicate comparability of underlying performance.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is strong and improved year over year, comfortably exceeding the sector median, with operating income dwarfing gross interest expense. Even a material earnings decline would leave ample headroom against the next risk-band boundary on a net-debt basis.

Cash flow to debt is adequate but declined year over year and trails the sector median, reflecting the larger debt base after acquisitions. Free cash flow to debt similarly softened, so deleveraging depends on sustained EBITDA growth rather than debt reduction alone.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is minimal, supported by low net leverage, very high interest coverage and a current ratio well above the sector median. Liquidity is ample, with cash and revolving capacity covering near-term maturities; our view is that the issuer remains a strong investment-grade-style credit.

Our forward view is stable but watchful: leverage sits above the sector median after acquisition funding, and shareholder returns plus deal activity absorb a meaningful share of free cash flow. Continued EBITDA growth and disciplined refinancing of the near-term maturities should keep metrics within the minimal-risk band.

credit_strengths.text: Amphenol 的營業利潤率按年大幅擴張，現時遠高於資訊科技行業中位數，反映其在資訊科技、工業及航空航天終端市場的互連系統具備定價能力及產品組合優勢。此盈利質素支撐現金產生，並為擴大的債務規模提供緩衝。
經營現金流以舒適倍數覆蓋資本開支加股東分派，而自由現金流單獨已覆蓋股息及回購，因此內部流動性可為增長提供資金而無需依賴外部再融資。現金結餘相對債務規模而言相當充裕。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿按年上升，現時高於行業中位數，原因為收購以債務融資導致債務規模增加逾倍。淨槓桿仍屬溫和，但略高於行業中位數，因此進一步以債務融資的交易將侵蝕現有緩衝。
債務附註顯示存在可觀的短期到期債務，包括於來年內到期的高級票據及歐元票據，以及緊隨其後到期的大額浮動利率票據。再融資使執行風險集中於較高利率環境，而浮動利率部分則增加票息敏感度。
披露的風險討論強調對非公認會計原則指標及收購相關費用的依賴，而約三分之二的銷售額來自美國以外。貨幣換算及所收購業務的整合可能對報告利潤率構成壓力，並使基本表現的可比性複雜化。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率強勁並按年改善，舒適地超過行業中位數，經營收入遠高於總利息支出。即使盈利大幅下降，按淨債務基準計算，相對下一個風險區間界限仍將留有充足餘地。
現金流對債務比率屬足夠，但按年下降並落後於行業中位數，反映收購後債務基數擴大。自由現金流對債務比率同樣轉弱，因此去槓桿取決於持續的 EBITDA 增長，而非僅靠削減債務。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為極低，支撐因素包括低淨槓桿、極高的利息覆蓋率，以及遠高於行業中位數的流動比率。流動性充裕，現金及循環信貸額度覆蓋短期到期債務；我們的觀點是該發行人仍屬強勁的投資級別類信用。
我們的前瞻觀點為穩定但保持審慎：收購融資後槓桿高於行業中位數，而股東回報加上交易活動佔用自由現金流的可觀份額。持續的 EBITDA 增長及對短期到期債務的有紀律再融資，應可使指標維持於極低風險區間之內。
